'''Andrew Davis''' (also billed as '''Andy Davis'''; forums handle '''Massasi'''; GEMP handle '''MassassiTT'''<ref name="ep4" />) hosts the ''Star Wars'' CCG YouTube channel [[Massassi Training Temple]].<ref name="ht-davis" /><ref name="ep4" /> He was a guest on [[Holotheatre]] on 23 November 2022.<ref name="ht-davis" />
